summary: Iteration 156 — Verified 4 Executive Overview power-ups end-to-end. BACKEND (pytest 6/6 pass): (1) GET /api/cra/ai-monitor?days=7|30|90 returns trend arrays of exact length 7/30/90 with avg_score/total_checks/flagged_total. (2) POST /api/cra/exec-snapshot creates snapshot with id; GET /api/cra/exec-snapshots lists it; DELETE /api/cra/exec-snapshot/{id} removes it and it is gone on re-list. (3) PUT /api/cra/exec-email/settings persists {enabled:true, day_of_week:2, hour_utc:9} — GET returns them under schedule{}. (4) POST /api/cra/exec-email/send-now returns 200 for admin. FRONTEND (Playwright, admin login via Enter-in-password, tour dismissed): Executive Overview /app renders v1.0.0 stamp (4 occurrences), cra-exec-snapshot-save, cra-exec-brief, cra-exec-open-governance, cra-exec-email panel with all 5 controls. Save schedule shows toast 'Board email schedule saved'. Save snapshot shows toast 'Snapshot saved' and the new snapshot row cra-exec-snapshot-{id} appears (went from 1 -> 2 rows). Delete button removes the row (2 -> 1). Deep-link pulse: clicking cra-exec-open-governance navigates to /app/cra-governance with cra-tab-mission ACTIVE and carrying class 'cra-tab-pulse'. Clicking cra-exec-open-assurance navigates and cra-tab-assurance is ACTIVE with class 'cra-tab-pulse' — cra-ai-monitor renders. AI Assurance range 7d/30d/90d buttons all clickable; header text updates ('7-day/30-day/90-day grounding trend'), avg score / checks / flagged update (checks 32 -> 33 -> 33), and GET /cra/ai-monitor is re-issued (verified via backend trend length).
